description: This file provides a set of functions for managing auction events, items, bids, and user authentication via Supabase in a React frontend application. It includes functions for creating events, sending magic links, fetching event details, managing auction items and bids, and subscribing to real-time updates.

methods.name: generateEventCode
methods.description: Generates a simple event code from a name by creating a slug and appending a random 4-digit number.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new auction event with a generated code and inserts it into the 'events' table.

methods.name: sendHostMagicLink
methods.description: Sends a passwordless magic link to a host's email for authentication, including eventId in the redirect URL.

methods.name: getEventByCode
methods.description: Fetches an event from the database by its unique code.

methods.name: getEventByName
methods.description: Fetches an event from the database by its name.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a new auction item to an event with specified details.

methods.name: listItems
methods.description: Lists all items associated with a specific event.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes an auction item by its ID.

methods.name: listBidsForItem
methods.description: Lists all bids for a specific item, ordered by amount descending.

methods.name: getHighBid
methods.description: Retrieves the highest bid for a specific item.

methods.name: placeBid
methods.description: Places a bid on an item after validating the bid amount and comparing it to the current high bid.

methods.name: subscribeToItems
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time updates for items in an event, returning an unsubscribe function.

methods.name: subscribeToBids
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time updates for bids on a specific item, returning an unsubscribe function.
